profile.Name: Bo
profile.Personality: Brash and cocky, she laughs through fights and boasts, 'Bow before Big Bo!' She hates slavers, says she fights for freedom and nothing else, and will not take orders or let anyone crowd her.
profile.Backstory: Anti-Slaver operative. She is found in Black Scratch with an Anti-Slaver ninja, and the Anti-Slavers call her Big Bo despite her small size. The United Cities and the Holy Nation have each put a price on her head, for terrorism and for spreading propaganda against forced labor. She boasts that no cage can hold her.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Loud and crude; laughs 'Bwahaha!' and calls opponents 'little worm'. Talks of breaking slaver skulls.
